summary: DesignCraft is a page layout app, like Adobe InDesign. You put text, pictures and charts on pages. Then you export the pages as PDF or images.
use_cases: Make a 1-page poster or flyer for an event.
Put a chart and 3 key numbers on a social media card.
Design a newsletter or a small magazine with several pages.
Make 100 name badges from 1 spreadsheet. DesignCraft puts 1 row of the spreadsheet on each badge.
story: DesignCraft made a 2-page poster in social media format (1080 × 1350 pixels). Page 1 shows 4 key numbers and the share of the conversation over 9 months. Page 2 shows which themes had the most negative posts. The charts and the badge came from VectorCraft.
recipe_note: Run the list of steps in poster.dcs. Export every page as a PNG image. Export all pages as 1 PDF.

assets.caption: Poster page 1 shows 4 key numbers and the share of the conversation, Jan–Sep 2026.
assets.description: DesignCraft put the title, the badge, 4 number cards, the VectorCraft line chart and 3 short findings on the page. Then it exported the page as a PNG image.
assets.how: designcraft-cli script poster.dcs --save poster.designcraft (197 commands from _work/designcraft/poster.py: file.new {width:1080, height:1350, pages:2}, swatch.create, frame.create, object.fill, object.cornerOptions, text.select + type.char + type.para, object.textFrameOptions, file.place {path:<VectorCraft PNG>}); designcraft-cli run --in poster.designcraft --scale 1 --all-pages pages/

assets.caption: Poster page 2 shows that 53% of Prices & tokens posts were negative. The average is 23%.
assets.description: DesignCraft put 3 items on page 2: the VectorCraft bar chart, a large 53% box and the platform pie chart. Then it exported the page as a PNG image.

assets.caption: This is the editable DesignCraft file, with the pictures inside.
assets.description: Open the file to change the text or to move the boxes on the page.

headless_notes: script and run worked without a window, and without --connect. Text colour must be a swatch name, so the script makes the palette swatches first. A raw hex colour gave invisible text. The bundled Inter font has only a Regular style, so the poster uses Segoe UI for bold text. A text frame that is too short hides its text, so each frame has room for its line height. The --page option counts from 0. vectorcraft-cli convert made a test image of the PDF for a visual check.
